value.rationale: The first hub reversal is a natural pathwise leadership-stability measure distinct from final consensus; the exact finite distribution and atomic-continuous universal limit uncover a sharp probability-one-half transition at 1/log 2 for a single minority hub uninterruptedly converting all opponents. This implies a rigorous surprising global-minority consensus lower bound for large stars, while respecting that the probability threshold is not a full-fixation threshold. The parameter, star topology, and stopping event are model-motivated, not arbitrary numerical slices.
